newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN EXTENDING HORIZONTAL TREND.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN EXTENDING HORIZONTAL TREND.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat on Thursday amid a three-week horizontal trend in the absence of fresh signal.

Analysts saw more of a sideways drift as new issues were drawing cash away from the secondary market while those holding on to stocks were reluctant to accept current prices, nine percent below the October 9 year-high.
Some also said the central bank deputy head's Tuesday comments on a possible rise in interest rates next year was bringing some uncertainty to the bourse.
Zywiec , which unexpectedly soared 9.9 percent on Wednesday, was seen dipping in a brief correction.
